justification.protectedBehavior: Record an individual web-home recovery failure, preserve unfinished durable state for retry, and continue to later owed audits while propagating requested cancellation unchanged.
justification.whyComplianceChangesBehavior: Propagating every home error repeatedly blocks later recovery. No registered-home owner contract specifies a complete set of recoverable exception classes, so an assumed narrower catch changes row-isolation behavior.
justification.protectedRisk: A broad catch can accidentally hide defects or swallow shutdown/cancellation, or falsely report failed work as completed.
justification.applicability: This is one intentional per-home recovery boundary after the requested-cancellation rethrow. It logs the actual exception and correlation identity, advances the cursor, and never marks that failed home completed.
justification.remainingControls: The tied-home regression asserts Error records and unfinished Preparing states, later audit exactly once, and revisiting homes. Cancellation regression asserts original exception identity, no error/audit, and later idempotent completion.
justification.repeatedExceptionReview: Existing resume/abort/lease/daemon/outbox boundaries show a recurring recovery pattern. Record separate rule applicability/scope review before adding further exceptions; review each contract individually and do not weaken CA1031 automatically.
